content.snl: def-hyp(list-partial(Type.judge(@F, Analysis.PFun), Type.judge(list-partial(@x, @D), Real)), list-partial(Analysis.derivLeft(F, x, D), Analysis.derivRight(F, x, D)), Analysis.limLeft(Div.div(Sub.sub(F, Type.apply(Analysis.map(F), x)), Sub.sub(@y, x)), @y, x, D))

values.en: The same difference quotient with the one-sided limits substituted. `F` is differentiable at `x₀` iff both one-sided derivatives exist and agree; `x ↦ |x|` at `0` is the standard example where they exist and differ.
values.zh-CN: 以同一个差商代入单侧极限。`F` 在 `x₀` 处可导，当且仅当两个单侧导数都存在且相等；`x ↦ |x|` 在 `0` 处是二者都存在但不相等的标准例子。
